subject: Qualification recap: model stability roadmap & follow-ups
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@brightpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Qualification recap: model stability roadmap & follow-ups

Thanks again for taking the time today, Lisa — good conversation and helpful clarity on BrightPay's top priorities (accuracy on tax-extraction fields, reduction in hallucinations for benefit descriptions, sub-200ms median latency for snippets). Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

What we heard
- Primary workload: structured extraction from semi-structured forms + follow-up clarification questions for edge cases.
- Acceptance test: ~500 sample documents (we asked for representative docs), plus a short set of golden prompts for accuracy checks.
- Procurement/terms: procurement is in loop (cc'd) and wants an explicit rollback/upgrade SLA.

Suggested candidates & quick rationale - redwood/gptj-3-quant@2025-06-30 — lowest token cost with acceptable extraction accuracy in our internal bench (see attached fit bench).
- redwood/llama-2-70b-int8-fp16@2025-05-20 — stronger few-shot extraction on our prompt set but higher latency/cost; good fallback if precision is prioritized.

Risk note (important)
- We flagged a potential quality regression pattern after a recent auto-update in hosted last week (some prompts produced more terse, less precise outputs). For customers in evaluation we recommend pinning to the tested model version and enabling a canary routing to the latest variant for 5-10% of traffic.

Immediate asks from BrightPay
1) Can you share the 500 sample docs and a short list of golden outputs?
2) Confirm whether procurement needs an explicit rollback clause in the MSA (we can propose wording).

Attachments: demo-prompts.csv (sample prompts we used), fit-bench-20250710.json (summary), additional eval writeup to follow.

Next calls - Technical deep-dive (model-fit + prompt tuning): Tue Jul 15, 10am PT (tentative)
- Procurement sync to review T&Cs: Wed Jul 16, 11am PT

I’ll loop in Marissa for an eval pack and Rishi for any rollout/rollback constraints.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@brightpay.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPay Procurement <procurement@brightpay.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Qualification recap: model stability roadmap & follow-ups

Thanks Vanessa — that matches our notes. A few quick clarifications: 
- We will aim to surface the 500 samples by EOD Monday; will include the 20 highest-priority forms.
- Procurement: we need a non-functional SLA around rollback/upgrade windows (we'll share the procurement template).
- On the two candidates: cost is important but the priority is that extraction precision must not drop below our baseline (we have an internal threshold of F1 >= 0.92 on the golden set).

Question: if we pin to a specific model version, what is the expected timeframe to rollback to the prior version if we detect regression? Do you have an internal SLA or typical timeline?

Lisa Chen
Head of Product, BrightPay
lisa.chen@brightpay.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@brightpay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Qualification recap: model stability roadmap & follow-ups

Hi all — following up with an eval snapshot based on the prompt set Vanessa attached. I exported a short PDF summary (redwood-eval-report-20250712.pdf) and included a quick TL;DR below.

TL;DR (500-doc simulation, 1k prompt samples)
- redwood/gptj-3-quant@2025-06-30: Precision 0.93 / Recall 0.90 / median latency 180ms (p95 420ms) — good cost/accuracy balance.
- redwood/llama-2-70b-int8-fp16@2025-05-20: Precision 0.95 / Recall 0.92 / median latency 420ms (p95 900ms) — best quality, higher latency.

Regression checks
- We ran an A/B of latest auto-upgraded hosted variant vs the pinned 2025-06-30 snapshot and saw a 4.8% drop in precision on a small set of follow-up prompts. Details in the attached report (section 3).

Recommended approach for BrightPay evaluation
1) Start in an evaluation project pinned to redwood/gptj-3-quant@2025-06-30.
2) Run the 500-sample golden set (we’ll provide the evaluation harness link).
3) If you need stronger precision for edge cases, run a limited pilot on llama-2-70b-int8 for the high-risk forms only.
4) Configure automated regression alerts (we can configure thresholds and Slack/HipChat hooks).

How to pin (example API snippet)

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/projects/BRIGHTPAY/pin -d '{"model": "redwood/gptj-3-quant", "version": "2025-06-30"}' 

I’ll attach the eval report to the hubspot deal and add the Drive evaluation pack.

—Marissa
Senior Applied ML | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@brightpay.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Qualification recap: model stability roadmap & follow-ups

Quick ops note — tagging this as high priority. During routine host updates on 2025-07-09 we observed an unintended model variant promotion in the hosted pool that affected a subset of requests (canary misrouting). Symptoms observed:
- Shorter completions on multi-turn clarifications (example diff below).
- Increase in hallucinated benefit descriptions in ~2% of sampled cases vs baseline.

Example diff (quoted):
> Prompt: "What are the employee benefits for plan X?"
> Baseline (2025-06-30): "Plan X includes medical, dental, 401k matching up to 4%, and 12 days PTO."
> Upgraded: "Plan X includes medical coverage and PTO."

Proposed immediate mitigation (we can do this in <2 hours)
1) Freeze auto-upgrades for BrightPay tenant (set tenant.auto_upgrade = false).
2) Pin production traffic to redwood/gptj-3-quant@2025-06-30.
3) Run a rapid regression pass (1000 golden prompts) and share a formal regression report.
4) If regression persists, schedule rollback of the promoted variant and open a postmortem.

Runbook (short)
- Step 1: Ops toggles tenant flag (infra)
- Step 2: Pin via API (Marissa or Ops)
- Step 3: Confirm metrics in Redwood Console and alert Slack channel #brightpay-monitor

I’ll own Step 3 with Marissa. Vanessa, if BrightPay wants a written rollback SLA, legal/procurement will need to surface acceptable windows (e.g., 4-hour emergency rollback SLA vs 24-hour).

—Rishi
Head of Production Engineering | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@brightpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, BrightPay Procurement <procurement@brightpay.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Qualification recap: model stability roadmap & follow-ups

Thanks team — solid ops plan. Lisa, to be concrete on next steps from Redwood: 
- Immediate: We will freeze auto-upgrades for BrightPay tenant and pin the evaluation project to redwood/gptj-3-quant@2025-06-30 today (Ops will confirm within 2 hours).
- Deliverables: evaluation harness + automated regression check (Marissa) and the full eval PDF delivered by end of day.
- Canary: we'll route 5% of traffic to latest variant for monitoring only (no impact to metrics that matter to you).
- Rollback SLA: we will propose a 4-hour emergency rollback window in the draft SOW and flag a 24-hour rollback guarantee for non-emergency changes. Procurement — please advise if that aligns with BrightPay's requirements.

Proposed timeline
- Mon Jul 14: BrightPay runs golden-set acceptance tests (we'll be available to help run them).
- Tue Jul 15: Technical deep-dive (prompt tuning, edge-case handling).
- Wed Jul 16: Procurement sync to review draft SOW language and rollback wording.

Action items assigned
- Ops: freeze auto-upgrades + pin evaluation project (Rishi).
- Applied ML: finalize eval report and attach Drive folder (Marissa).
- AE: confirm meeting invites and HubSpot notes (Vanessa).

If you confirm receipt, Lisa, we’ll proceed with the pin today and share a short status update in this thread.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
